# ChunkDoc

AI-powered document analysis tool built for medical students at Stellenbosch University Tygerberg campus.

## What it does

Allows users to upload PDF medical documents (clinical guidelines, study notes, research papers) and ask questions about their contents in plain English. Uses RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) with pgvector to find relevant chunks before passing them to GPT-4o-mini for an answer.

## Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: FastAPI, Python
- AI: OpenAI GPT-4o-mini, pgvector (PostgreSQL)
- Deployment: Vercel (frontend), Render (API)

## Live

https://doc-analyzer-as5k.vercel.app
